summary: Revise: vector-blind cues solve all five delivered batch questions; homogeneous cases fix No solution; three source profiles are missing; explicit subtraction parameters can produce a wrong key. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solving for one coefficient in a linear combination of two column vectors.
reasoning_steps: Substitute the given vectors into c a1 +/- x a2 = b or 0.
Isolate x a2 by vector subtraction with the appropriate sign.
Read a candidate scalar from a nonzero component and verify all remaining components.
Choose exactly one scalar or No solution from the complete radio bank.
invariants: One unknown scalar, two known equal-dimensional vectors, known scalar multiplier, vector addition/subtraction only.
Unique scalar or no solution; exclude all-zero unknown vector leading to infinitely many solutions unless source-supported.
Keep componentwise vector isolation and the source workload; do not introduce multi-unknown systems.
permitted_variations: Change integer coordinates, dimension 2–4, known coefficient and sign, unknown symbol, and scalar answer including zero where unique.
Change the consistency-determining component, positions of zero entries, and which options represent the answer.

Homogeneous versus explicit-target form need not dictate consistency: consistent homogeneous and inconsistent nonzero-target instances are eligible same-method extensions, with difficulty justified by reasoning.
Permute choices and vary full bank profiles including observed banks without No solution.

source_replay.details: Nine supported profiles replay vector data, full mathematical banks, correct key and ordered solution matrices. Three complete rated source questions q-34572, q-105153, q-105156 have no profile. Unrated q-34250 is separately documented as incomplete.

math.details: 54 fresh and 5 runner records pass independent Fraction-based component checks and solution residual checks. Direct subtraction parameters c=2 are accepted and emit an inconsistent prompt with stored key 2; native grader accepts that wrong key. Normal sampler excludes this parameter.

variety.details: Each easy bank fixes answer sign and numeric rank relationships; every homogeneous draw is inconsistent. Surface coordinate/coefficient variation preserves vector-blind response rules. Both fresh controls and exact delivered batch fail.

scope.details: Observed normal outputs retain one scalar, dimensions 2–4, basic vector operations and five-choice radio response; no unsupported prerequisites or added reasoning stages. Missing source families are recorded under source replay.

grading.details: Actual native grade_field: 123 accepted correct selections, 492 rejected distractors, no unresolved checks, no database writes. Includes delivered normalized records and applicable counterfactuals. Radio provides no free-entry equivalent notation. Separate boundary failure is a wrong authored key, not a native grading limitation.

rendering.details: 14 actual UI previews pass MathJax/fonts/images/JavaScript checks. Five representative screenshots visually inspected, including subtraction, inconsistent homogeneous and opposite-sign counterfactual cases.

packaging.details: Exact Python 3.13.5 and sympy 1.14.0 match nested manifest dependency contract. Deterministic replay, isolated relocation and --output match. All package file hashes unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Visible symbol/bank/RHS cues predict all 54 fresh responses and all five runner responses, including after delivery. Controlled role reversal is valid but never normally sampled; homogeneous consistency reversal is rejected. Actual choice shuffling does not defeat value-based cues.

findings.description: All five actual runner questions can be answered without reading vectors. In visible l plus No solution subgroup, the only negative option is always correct (2/2 runner, 6/6 independent). l numeric-only uses second-largest; h uses largest. Other easy label subgroups likewise have perfect numeric-rank rules. This is a family-wide construction defect and a demonstrated batch-selection failure.

Seed 2406259497, q-34249, a=[9,-2,0,7],u=[-1,5,-2,8],c=5,s=-1. delivery-batch/accepted.json retains the normalized record; coverage.json measures all five.
findings.requested_change: Change normal scalar/sign domains and complete distractor-bank construction so label or bank-sign/rank signatures do not determine which value is correct. Retain exact source replay separately, add eligible opposite-sign and bank-role cases at the same workload, and regenerate a batch that passes subgroup probes. Option shuffling alone is insufficient.
